svg.aria-label: Block diagram of the matmul PPA test chip
svg.text: INT8 GEMM candidate benchmark, IHP SG13G2 130 nm target. A is 32x32, B is 32x32, C = A B in INT32. Tile 4x4x4, tile grid 8x8x8, 32768 MACs per run.
PAD FRAME (pad_frame.sv, IHP IO cell hook)
pins oversampled in the core domain
golden C, loaded by the host
sram_1rw: one port, byte enables, one cycle read
PDK macro hook at this boundary
signed partial products, 3:2 CSA tree, 1 cycle
radix-4 Booth recoding, 3:2 CSA tree, 1 cycle
one identical interface for every candidate:
launch, ready, valid, mac_tick, a_tile, b_tile, c_tile
shared acc_bank keeps the output tile resident across the K loop
adding a sixth candidate touches only this column
walks store C against store REF
read back over SPI with OP_RD_PERF and OP_RD_STATUS; also exposed on four status pads
